name: vivarium-night-r2
refs: THE PICTURE TO EDIT (the vivarium by day: keep everything, change only the light):
THE FIRST NIGHT ATTEMPT (keep its glow-moss and glowing mushrooms and its mood, but fix the following: it is too dark and its top band is blue-teal):
prompt: Output a NEW image: the same vivarium picture at NIGHT, brighter and warmer than the first attempt. The light is warm and low and the picture is clearly readable, a warm mid-tone overall (average brightness about 35 to 40 percent, never dark or black): small warm glowing patches of glow-moss, glowing lichen and a few glowing mushrooms on the moss, stones and roots, a warm amber lamp glow from the upper left, warm brown-olive shadows that are still visible, the burrow, water, moss and stones all clearly legible. IMPORTANT COLOUR RULE: everything is warm (amber, orange, olive, brown, moss green): the canopy band at the top and the foliage behind must be a warm dark olive and amber-lit green, NOT blue and NOT teal; the moon appears ONLY as a very thin pale cool rim of light on the top edges of a few leaves and stones at the upper left, and nowhere else is there any blue or cool tone. Keep the picture EXACTLY the same in composition and content as the day picture: the same canopy band at the top, feed line, mister, vent, burrow, water, stones, roots, moss and plants in the same places and sizes, the same matte sculpted miniature rendering. Still NO creatures, no text, no letters, no digits, no frame, no glossy surfaces, no neon.
